scripts.install:api: cd apps/api && python3 -m venv venv && ./venv/bin/python -m pip install -q --upgrade pip && ./venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.db:seed: cd apps/api && ./venv/bin/python -c 'from app.seed import seed_database; from app.database import SessionLocal; db = SessionLocal(); seed_database(db)'
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run install:api && npm run env:api && npm run db:migrate
